subject: life-orientation-sp
description: Life Orientation Senior Phase (Grades 7–9). CAPS-aligned. Four desk topics done every grade (Development of the self in society; Health, social & environmental responsibility; Constitutional rights & responsibilities; World of work). Physical Education is excluded as it is movement-based. All skills open once the grade is selected (gate NONE). Essay/project/discussion work is reframed into tap-only knowledge and scenario questions. No free text.
